name: alta
description: Find prospects, build multi-channel outbound campaigns, and track replies, meetings and pipeline in your Alta account.

interface.longDescription:
Alta is the AI platform built for go-to-market teams - agents that find prospects, qualify leads and book meetings, so your team can focus on closing. Connect your Alta account and do that work from the chat, in plain language.

What you can do:
- Find the right companies and people. Search Alta's company and people data, built from 50+ data sources, by industry, company size, location, role and seniority, and see how many match before you commit.
- Target on buying signals. Enrich an audience with buying signals such as funding, hiring and job changes, and focus outreach on the accounts showing intent, so it lands when the timing is right.
- Build campaigns from a brief. Describe who you want to reach, and Alta drafts the campaign: the audience, a pitch from your company knowledge, a multichannel sequence across email, LinkedIn and calls, and the sending rep. Open the draft in Alta to launch it.
- Automate multi-step processes. Describe a workflow in plain language, and Alta builds or edits it in Workflows.
- Bring in your CRM. Import a list from HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive and others into an audience and run a campaign on it.
- Run the day-to-day. Check campaigns, prospects, replies, tasks, calls and the meetings Alta booked, and ask questions about your account's performance.
- Reply in context. Draft and send email and LinkedIn messages to prospects, with your confirmation before anything is sent.

Who it's for: sales leaders, reps and RevOps teams who already use Alta.

Limitations: requires an Alta account, and every action runs with that account's permissions. Contact details (emails, phone numbers) are not returned in search previews; enrichment happens inside Alta. Campaigns are launched in the Alta app, not from the chat. Sending a message, resuming a campaign or running enrichment has real effects, so the assistant asks before it does any of them.
defaultPrompt: Find US SaaS companies showing buying intent
Build a campaign for RevOps leaders at UK fintechs
Which campaign is booking the most meetings?

positive.description: Search Alta's people dataset by ideal customer profile and return a match count with previews, without contact details.
positive.prompt: Find VPs of Sales at SaaS companies in the United States with 50 to 500 employees.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the total number of matching people and up to 10 previews (name, title, company). No emails or phone numbers are shown.

positive.description: Build a draft campaign end to end, pausing for the user's approval at the audience step.
positive.prompt: Create a campaign targeting heads of RevOps at fintech companies in the United Kingdom.
positive.expected_behavior: Loads the campaign-creation skill, searches for the audience, shows the match count and previews, and asks whether to start a campaign with this audience before creating anything.

positive.description: Continue the draft campaign after the user approves the audience: create the draft and generate the pitch.
positive.prompt: Yes, start the campaign with this audience.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft campaign, saves the audience on it, generates a pitch from the account's knowledge base, shows a link to open the draft in Alta, and asks whether to use the pitch. Nothing is sent to prospects.

positive.description: List the account's campaigns and summarize their status.
positive.prompt: Show me my campaigns and which ones are active.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's campaigns with their names and statuses, and points out which ones are active.

positive.description: List the meetings Alta booked in a date range.
positive.prompt: Which meetings did Alta book this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the meetings booked in the current month with the prospect, company and meeting time, or says that none were booked.

negative.description: Request unrelated to sales prospecting or the user's Alta account; the plugin should not call any Alta tool.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to New York next Friday.

negative.description: Request for a specific person's private contact details; Alta does not return emails or phone numbers in chat, so the assistant should decline and explain that enrichment happens inside Alta.
negative.prompt: Give me the personal mobile number and home address of the CEO of Acme Corp.

negative.description: Bulk destructive request that Alta's tools do not support; the assistant should not act and should explain that campaigns are managed in the Alta app.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my campaigns and prospects.

review.commerce_description: Alta does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Updated the listing: a new short description, a long description that covers buying signals, workflow automation and the campaign brief, two new capabilities (Target buying signals, Automate workflows) and new starter prompts. No tool changes.
